title: Turkish Kebabs with Zesty Silky Sauce
description: A keto friendly dish featuring marinated Turkish kebabs served with a zesty and silky sauce made from scratch.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together flour, zesty, and silky.
Add the Turkish kebabs to the bowl and toss to coat.
Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and arrange the kebabs.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until the kebabs are cooked through.
Meanwhile, mix the remaining sauce ingredients in a separate bowl.
Once the kebabs are done, brush the sauce on top of each kebab.
Note: If you prefer a crispy exterior, broil the kebabs for an additional 2-3 minutes.
